scope: Local artifact validation only; not a deployed reference environment

checks.detail: 4 GitHub workflows and 1 parameterized ACA Job template
Every external action uses a 40-character commit SHA
Hosted runner, read-only token, no OIDC permission
Separate environments; shared release/rollback serialization group
All Bash run blocks parsed after expression substitution
SVG and editable draw.io XML parse successfully
All local image and sample links resolve
All 17 sample files are linked from the guide
24 named placeholders intentionally require customer values
actionlint 1.7.12 passed all 4 workflows; downloaded Windows binary SHA-256 verified against upstream checksums. ShellCheck was not available; Bash syntax was checked separately.
Local server returned HTTP 200 and exact message/commit JSON for / and /health; unknown path returned 404. Server shut down after testing.

Rebuilt simplified SVG rendered in the browser and screenshot inspected; every node and heading sits inside its box, and the generator asserts text fit at build time. Subtitle, legend and rotated edge labels were checked visually.

not_validated_live: Azure resources, network, DNS, roles and OIDC token exchange
GitHub protection rules, real runner scaling, deployment and rollback
ACA Job template acceptance in a live subscription
Docker image build: local Docker Linux daemon unavailable
Dedicated ACR Tasks agent pool pricing: no figure is given in the guide
